acceptance.goal: Raft runtime correctness: a new leader commits a no-op, ReadIndex serves linearizable reads, propose reports only the entry it proposed, and the status and replica-lag accessors are public
Truthful observability and bounded service foundations: admission config, body limits, efficiency and stability dimensions, phase-stable soak sampling, and an honest process-sampling promise
peer-tls: distinct refusals for an anchorless bundle and a foreign issuer, and the mTLS config service calls plan_server and plan_client
service-k8s: core-owned service operations are recorded, and a zero-replica stateful plan returns an error instead of panicking

Reviewed CI and release gates: unit checks run before integration and performance, failure reasons are reviewed, legacy delivery entrypoints are retired, and the release contract is reviewed before tagging
The workspace version is 0.5.0 and the 0.5.0 release notes cover every crate
